status: Codex engineering correction; original model plan preserved
termination_reason: The historical corrected-A iteration-59 returned iterate was mathematically infeasible, not an established optimum. Agreement between saved and tightly reconstructed original-grid states does not establish optimality. One fixed schedule showed substantial time-discretization effects but did not identify a unique or dominant cause, exclude weights/design effects, or establish convergence of the 0.005 s grid. The historical solver problem predates the two-slack search formulation, so the new solve is not the same optimization problem. Saved-schedule initialization reuses tensions only and regenerates states continuously from the prescribed physical zero state at the chosen design and grid; saved 36-node states are not copied to the refined solve. Two historical refined solves actually returned optimal termination for the relaxed NLP, but their vectors were never saved and remain unrecoverable. These corrections concern evidence and execution semantics and prescribe no weights, design choice, hypothesis revision or final decision.
